note: Curated, not exhaustive - the most significant/widely-covered NVDA partnerships announced in calendar year 2026. Manually researched and verified; re-run scripts/nvda_partnerships.py to refresh.

partnerships.description: NVIDIA invests $3.5B in MediaTek convertible bonds; MediaTek adopts NVLink Fusion for custom XPUs in NVLink-connected AI factories, co-develops chips for RTX Spark/DGX Spark PCs, continues automotive SoC work. Same playbook as Marvell: direct capital + ecosystem lock-in to a rising ASIC player rather than treating it as a pure GPU competitor.

NVIDIA invests $2B directly in Marvell, bundled with an NVLink Fusion partnership - Marvell builds custom XPUs and NVLink Fusion-compatible scale-up networking interoperable with NVIDIA Vera CPUs, ConnectX NICs, BlueField DPUs and Spectrum-X switches, plus joint silicon-photonics work. A major hyperscaler ASIC design partner (Amazon Trainium, Google TPU) now financially aligned with NVIDIA instead of purely competing with it.

NVIDIA invests $2B in Nebius (~8-9% stake, plus warrants) - Nebius targets 5GW of NVIDIA chip deployment by 2030 with early access to next-gen Vera Rubin chips and joint rack co-design/fleet-management work. A "neocloud" GPU-cloud provider built up as an alternative capacity source to the traditional hyperscalers, financially tied to NVIDIA.

NVIDIA's largest and longest-running neocloud bet: early pre-IPO investor, ~7% stake at March 2025 IPO, added ~$2B (24.2M shares) in Jan 2026 taking it to ~13%, then increased again in Q1 2026 to 47.2M+ shares (~11%, ~$4.9B) - NVIDIA's second-largest shareholder. CoreWeave commits to deploying future NVIDIA infrastructure (Rubin GPUs, Vera CPUs) for its 5GW-by-2030 buildout.

5GW AI infrastructure deal; NVIDIA holds a 5-year right to buy up to 30M IREN shares (~$2.1B) - the same warrant-based alignment structure as Nebius, backing another emerging neocloud capacity source.

NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm) stakes across multiple quantum computing startups - individually small, but the same pattern as the ASIC/neocloud bets: early financial alignment with potential future compute paradigms rather than waiting to see who wins.

$1.5B equity investment in SB Energy as part of the signed OpenAI Ohio data center deal (20-year, 10GW lease) - bundled with a $105B credit-support backstop and exclusive first-half chip supply rights. See the debt-financing table below for the full backstop-size evolution ($250B -> <$120B -> $105B) and the Japan power-financing angle.

NVIDIA backed UK neocloud Nscale from its Series B through a $2B Series C (2026), taking it to a $14.6B valuation - Nscale is now preparing a ~$3B US IPO, chasing CoreWeave's playbook. Same pattern as Nebius/IREN: warrant/equity alignment with an emerging GPU-capacity provider before it scales independently.

NVIDIA invested $50M in Figure AI's Series B (Feb 2024, $675M round, $2.6B valuation) and participated again in its Series C (Sept 2025, $1B+ round, $39B valuation) - one of NVIDIA's earliest and largest humanoid-robotics equity bets, distinct from the broader Isaac/Omniverse robotics tooling coalition below.

$5B equity stake (initial purchase price) tied to jointly developing x86 CPUs with NVIDIA NVLink/RTX GPU chiplets for PCs and data centers - not an emerging challenger like the other Kingmaker bets, but buys product co-design influence over the incumbent x86 roadmap. Per NVIDIA's Q2 FY2026 13F, the position had appreciated to ~$30B.

~$21B stake per NVIDIA's Q2 FY2026 13F filing - outside the AI-compute ecosystem NVIDIA otherwise builds (space launch/Starlink), read more as a large opportunistic venture return than an ecosystem-lock-in play like the others in this category.
Deploying 1M+ NVIDIA GPUs (Blackwell GB200 NVL72, moving to Rubin) across AWS regions.
Among first clouds offering Grace Blackwell GB200 + Quantum-X800 InfiniBand across Azure/Fabric/365.
Adopting the Grace Blackwell platform plus NVIDIA DGX Cloud service.
Anthropic signed a $35B compute deal with NVIDIA-backed cloud provider Lambda; NVIDIA holds the lease on the Nueces County, TX data center (built by Hut 8) powering it.

NVIDIA to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9B, confirmed via SEC 8-K filing Sept 3 2026 - includes a $1B employee retention package. Hugging Face's CEO says the company approached Huang about a deal over the summer; expected to close H1 2027. Hugging Face stays an open platform for the whole AI ecosystem, not NVIDIA-exclusive. Extends an investor relationship dating to 2023 into NVIDIA's largest acquisition ever.
NVIDIA finalized a $30B equity stake in OpenAI's $110B funding round - a scaled-down cut of the original $100B/10GW commitment disclosed in 2025.

NVIDIA participated in Mistral's ASML-led $2B Series C (Sept 2025, valuing Mistral at ~$13.8B) - exact NVIDIA-specific amount undisclosed. Also a founding member of NVIDIA's Nemotron Coalition, co-developing open frontier models (Mistral 3), deployed across NVIDIA compute and tooling.

$10B equity stake as part of Anthropic's Series G, alongside Microsoft's $5B - direct capital into a top-3 AI lab, distinct from the Lambda compute deal (Anthropic is also a Lambda customer, separately).
Reported to be in talks for an investment at ~$30B valuation - not yet closed.
5-year, $1B strategic partnership for AI-driven drug discovery.

partnerships.partner: Mayo Clinic / IQVIA / Illumina / Arc Institute
partnerships.description: Mayo deploying DGX Blackwell + MONAI imaging platform; IQVIA/Illumina/Arc on genomics, clinical-trial AI agents, expanded BioNeMo platform.
Expanded partnership into AI factories, smart cities, traffic intelligence, and manufacturing, beyond existing DRIVE work.
New CLA uses NVIDIA DRIVE AV software for enhanced Level 2 driver assistance.
New automaker adopters of NVIDIA's robotaxi-ready compute/software stack.

partnerships.partner: ABB / Universal Robots / KUKA / Boston Dynamics / Figure / 1X / Agility / AGIBOT / NEURA / Skild AI
partnerships.description: Robotics coalition integrating NVIDIA Isaac/Omniverse physical-AI models for humanoid and industrial robots.

Sovereign AI stack (AIOS-RA on 8x Blackwell Ultra + Spectrum-X); expanded mid-2026 to give US federal agencies/critical-infrastructure operators customizable models (via NVIDIA Nemotron) inside air-gapped/classified networks.
South Korea sovereign AI factory, starting at 55MW at GAK Sejong.
20,000+ Blackwell Ultra GPUs deployed for the IndiaAI Mission; Reliance building a GB300-powered sovereign AI backbone with Omniverse digital twins in Jamnagar.
Strategic AI-factory partnership - ~$100B committed across 11 data centers/2.2GW, NVIDIA's largest single Gulf sovereign AI commitment.

partnerships.partner: G42 / Stargate UAE (Oracle, OpenAI, Cisco, SoftBank)
partnerships.description: Stargate UAE consortium targeting 1GW, plus a separate UAE-US AI Campus with direct NVIDIA hardware commitments - NVIDIA's anchor role in the Gulf's other major sovereign AI push alongside Saudi Arabia.
Industrial AI Cloud for Germany, up to 10,000 Blackwell GPUs, live Q1 2026 - distinct from Deutsche Telekom's separate role in the 6G Coalition below.

$3.2B warrant deal plus multi-year commercial partnership for optical-connectivity technology (fiber, connectors) - part of NVIDIA's ~$6.5B photonics push (with Coherent/Lumentum) to solve the copper interconnect bottleneck in scale-up AI data centers.

$2B equity investment each (Series A Convertible Preferred for Lumentum) - the two leading suppliers of optical transceivers/components NVIDIA's Quantum-X/Spectrum-X co-packaged-optics networking roadmap depends on, secured with capital rather than just purchase orders.

$2B investment plus expanded partnership to accelerate chip design and engineering simulation (EDA) workloads on NVIDIA compute - secures a stake in the tool NVIDIA's own next-gen chips (and its customers') get designed with.

Multiyear memory/technology partnership tied to the Vera Rubin/Vera CPU/RTX Spark/Jetson Thor roadmap, reportedly worth up to $500B over multiple years including an SK Telecom-built 2GW AI factory. By dollar value, dwarfs every other single-company deal on this page - but structured as a supply/technology commitment, not an equity stake, so kept in its own category rather than folded into Strategic Investment (Kingmaker).
